goy_shell_model.description: Sabra shell model, Eulerian multifractal cascade at high Re
goy_shell_model.physics: GOY/Sabra shell model captures multifractal energy cascade. Structure functions S_p(n) = <|u_n|^p> ~ k_n^{-zeta_p}. Anomalous scaling of zeta_p encodes intermittency corrections to Kolmogorov K41.

kraichnan_model.description: Lagrangian tracers in Kraichnan (delta-correlated in time) velocity field
kraichnan_model.physics: Kraichnan model has exact RG solution. Velocity spectrum E(k) ~ k^{1-xi}. Exact result: tracer MSD ~ t^{xi} (anomalous with H=xi/2). For xi > 1: superdiffusion (Lévy-like). The fractional operator exponent alpha = 2/xi. This provides the exact mapping from turbulence spectrum roughness (xi) to the fractional Laplacian exponent (alpha).

kolmogorov_tracers.description: Lagrangian tracers in synthetic turbulence with Kolmogorov spectrum
kolmogorov_tracers.physics: Pure K41: E(k) ~ k^{-5/3}. Kolmogorov exact result: Richardson t^3 law for pair dispersion; for single-particle diffusion in K41 flow, MSD ~ t^3 (Lévy-like superdiffusion). Intermittency corrections (beta model) shift the effective scaling exponent.

key_physics.RG_argument: The spectral roughness parameter xi of the velocity field controls the fixed point of the RG flow. Under coarse-graining (integrating out k > Lambda), the diffusion operator renormalizes from -D*nabla^2 to -D_eff * (-nabla^2)^{alpha/2} where alpha = 2/xi for xi > 1.
key_physics.connection_eulerian_lagrangian: Structure function scaling zeta_p from GOY model -> velocity spectrum roughness xi -> tracer anomalous diffusion H=xi/2 -> fractional Laplacian exponent alpha=2/xi
key_physics.half_laplacian: The half-Laplacian (-nabla^2)^{1/2} corresponds to alpha=1, which requires xi=2 (rough turbulence at the boundary of validity). Physical turbulence with xi~5/3 gives alpha ~ 1.2 (close to but not exactly the half-Laplacian).
